```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")
```

Processed based on RNAseq data
```{r}
#Load RNAseq data
counts = read.csv("../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
traitData = traitData[traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts),] # Filter for patients with RNAseq
counts = counts[,traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data
all.equal(traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order

traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(.data$AN, paste(patients, collapse = "|"))) %>% # Filter for patients with spatial data
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") %>%
  dplyr::select(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, KRAS, BRAF, MET, PFS, PFS_event, R.NR, Age_diag, Gender, Tabac, Centre)

counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk] #Subset RNAseq based on available spatial information
all.equal(colnames(counts), traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk) #Verify they still are in the same order
colnames(counts) = rownames(traitData)
traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::select(-N_Raw_matrice_Bulk)

## Filter spatial data
for (i in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  data_spatial[[i]] = data_spatial[[i]][rownames(traitData),]
}
```

Normalize counts
```{r}
counts.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
```

Create matrix of features
```{r}
### Add identifier Patient to avoid joining other characters
rownames(traitData) = paste0("Patient_", rownames(traitData))
colnames(counts.norm) = paste0("Patient_", colnames(counts.norm))
for (i in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  rownames(data_spatial[[i]]) = paste0("Patient_", rownames(data_spatial[[i]]))
}

spatial_features = apply(do.call(cbind, data_spatial), 2, as.numeric)
traitData = cbind(traitData, spatial_features)
rownames(spatial_features) = rownames(traitData)
```

###### From 112 patients with clinical data, only 62 have spatial data
###### From 68 patients with spatial data in each stroma, tumor, total only 62 have clinical info
###### From 62 patients with spatial data only 54 have RNAseq
###### From 116 patients with RNAseq, all of them has clinical info (incomplete for some traits but present in clinical file) 

```{r}
source("src/environment_set.R") #Load functions and packages
```

Compare correlation with DC markers and spatial proportions
```{r}
markers = c("XCR1", "CLEC9A", "BATF3", "IRF8", "FCER1A", "CD1C", "IRF4", "CLEC4C", "FSCN1", "CCR7", "LY75", "CCL22", "CD40", "BIRC3", "NFKB2", "IL12B",
            "CLEC10A", "LAMP3", "CD8A")
markers_expression = counts.norm[rownames(counts.norm)%in%markers,]
markers_expression = log2(markers_expression+1)

deconv = deconv[,grep("DWLS", colnames(deconv))]
colnames(deconv) = stringr::str_replace(colnames(deconv), "CBSX.NSCLC.Zilionis.scRNAseq", "Zilionis")
deconv = deconv[,-grep("tpDC", colnames(deconv))]
compute.modules.relationship(deconv[,grep(paste0(c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3"), collapse = "|"), colnames(deconv)), drop = F], t(markers_expression), "Markers-spatial", width = 15, height = 4, par_mar = c(5, 35, 5, 3))

compute.modules.relationship(spatial_features[,grep("Total", colnames(spatial_features)), drop = F], t(markers_expression), "Markers-spatial", width = 12, height = 8)

## Markers DC1 = c("XCR1", "CLEC9A", "BATF3")
scatter_plots(t(counts.norm[rownames(counts.norm)%in%c("XCR1", "CLEC9A", "BATF3"), ,drop = F]), spatial_features[,"Tumor.cDC1+", drop = F], "pearson", y_up = 0.004)

## Markers DC2 = c("FCER1A", "CD1C")
scatter_plots(t(counts.norm[rownames(counts.norm)%in%c("FCER1A", "CD1C"), ,drop = F]), spatial_features[,"Tumor.cDC2+", drop = F], "pearson", y_up = 0.02)

## Markers DC3 = c("FSCN1", "CCR7", "LY75", "CCL22", "CD40", "BIRC3", "NFKB2")
scatter_plots(t(counts.norm[rownames(counts.norm)%in%c("FSCN1", "CCR7", "LY75", "CCL22", "CD40", "BIRC3", "NFKB2"), ,drop = F]), spatial_features[,"Tumor.Mature_DC+", drop = F], "pearson", y_up = 0.005)
```

Analysis is done with 54 patients (RNAseq + spatial + clinical information)

Compute BayesPrism
```{r}
load("Metacells.RData")
deconvolution.results.bayesprism <- omnideconv::deconvolute_bayesprism(bulk_gene_expression = counts.norm,
                                           single_cell_object = counts_all,
                                           cell_type_annotations = metadata_all$general,
                                           cell_subtype_labels = metadata_all$new_annotation,
                                           n_cores=8)

deconv = deconvolution.results.bayesprism$bp.res@posterior.initial.cellState@theta

library(dplyr)
deconv <- deconv %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename("B.memory" = "B.cells.memory",
                "B.naive" = "B.cells.naive",
                "CD8.cells" = "T.cells.CD8",
                "CD4.naive" = "T.cells.CD4.naive",
                "CD4.memory.activated" = "T.cells.CD4.memory.activated",
                "CD4.memory.resting" = "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting",
                "Mast.activated" = "Mast.cells.activated",
                "Mast.resting" = "Mast.cells.resting",
                "Macrophages.M0" = "Macrophages.M0",
                "Macrophages.M2" = "Macrophages.M2",
                "Plasma" = "Plasma.cells",
                "T.cells.helper" = "T.cells.follicular.helper",
                "T.cells.regulatory" = "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.",
                "NK.resting" = "NK.cells.resting")

colnames(deconv) = paste0("BayesPrism_Zilionis_", colnames(deconv))
```

```{r}
dendritic_deconv = deconv[,grep(paste0(c("DC1", "DC2", "DC3", "DC4", "DC5"), collapse = "|"), colnames(deconv))]
rownames(spatial_features) = rownames(dendritic_deconv)

scatter_plots(dendritic_deconv, spatial_features[,"Tumor.Mature_DC+"], method = "pearson", x_down = 0.5, y_up = 0.01)
compute.modules.relationship(dendritic_deconv, spatial_features, "DC-Spatial_abundance", height = 15, width = 20, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
```

Dictionary deconvolution
```{r}

dict = deconvolution_dictionary(deconv, pathways)
deconv = dict[[1]]
clusters = dict[[2]]
```

TF activity
```{r}
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm)
```

TF network
```{r}
network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.7, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 
```

Metadata association 
```{r}
coldata = traitData %>%
  dplyr::select(-Centre, -PFS, -KRAS, -BRAF, -MET, -PFS_event, -Age_diag, -Gender, -Tabac)

compute.metada.association(network[[1]], coldata, pval = 0.05, width = 14, height = 8) 
```

Pathways activity inference
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm)
#Association of TFs modules with pathways
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], pathways, "Pathways_Progeny-TFs_Modules", width = 10)
```

Benchmarking deconvolution and spatial
```{r}
source("src/pseudobulk_function.R")

for(i in 1:length(data_spatial)){
  #Rename spatial features
  spatial_features <- data_spatial[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::rename("CD8.cells" = "CD8+",
                  "Cancer" = "Tumor_cells+",
                  "tDC1" = "cDC1+",
                  "tDC2" = "cDC2+",
                  "tpDC" = "pDC+",
                  "tDC3" = "Mature_DC+") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Dendritic.cells = rowSums(across(c(tpDC, tDC1, tDC2, tDC3))))
  
  #Correlation plot deconvolution vs groundtruth
  corr_matrix = benchmarking_deconvolution(deconv, spatial_features, include_combinations = "BayesPrism_Zilionis", corr_type = "spearman", scatter = T, pval = 0.05, paste0("Gobbini_spatial_", names(data_spatial)[i]), width = 14, height = 8)  
}
```

Deconvolution analysis
```{r}
dt = compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconv, corr = 0.7, seed = 123, cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3"), low_variance = F) 
#Association of TFs modules with deconvolution 
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], dt[[1]], "Deconvolution-TFs_Modules", vertical = T, height = 30, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(3, 30, 5, 1))
```

Cell groups identification
```{r}
cell_groups = construct_cell_groups(counts.norm, tfs, deconv, network, dt, traitData, trait = "R.NR", positive = "R")
```

Module correlation
```{r}
rownames(spatial_features) = rownames(traitData)
compute.modules.relationship(cell_groups[[1]], spatial_features, "Cell_groups-Spatial_abundance", height = 15, width = 20, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], spatial_features, "Network-Spatial_abundance", height = 5, width = 15, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
```

Save CellTFusion results
```{r}
save(cell_groups, tfs, network, pathways, dt, file = "Results_features_Gobbini.RData")
```
